info.title: Enterprise Gateway Administration
info.description: Platform operators: gateway-admin audience; gateway.read for GET, gateway.write for changes. PATCH replaces the whole body. Revisions use If-Match. Named policies resolve at publication. No general durable idempotency replay except quota corrections.

headers.description: Only literal X-API-Version and X-Release predicates

retries.description: Only GET/HEAD routes may retry; maximum one additional attempt

get.summary: Inspect consumer key lifecycle without secrets

200.description: Identifiers, scopes, roles, expiry, revocation; no plaintext secret

post.summary: Correct current UTC usage with CAS and idempotency
